topic.title: Discrete Clock for SoC-North and Compute

body.p: By default bclk is coming from SoC-south Fabric PLL. There is also option to have discrete bclk for SoC-north and compute which is generated from local bclkpll respectively. Bclk for GFX/Base will follow whichever used by SoC-north. All dielets D2DPLL refclk also used the same bclk which follow whichever used by SoC-north.

BCLKPLL (either SoC-north or compute) can be enabled for two purposes:
Overclocking
SSC Mitigation

Bclk config mode can be selected through:
PMC soft strap (pulled by Intel® CSME)
User configure through BIOS (write to RTC backed register in SoC-south)
PMC receive both above during reset, user configuration take precedence, send the value to SoC-north through EPOC2. Soc-north will send to compute through PMSB.
